exercise.name: Jumping Jack
exercise.description: Full-body cardio exercise. Jump the feet out while sweeping the arms overhead, then return.
exercise.camera_setup: Face the camera, full body in frame

faults.label: Arms not overhead
faults.cue: Reach all the way up — bring your hands above your head
faults.cue_side: Your {side} arm isn't reaching overhead — swing it all the way up

faults.label: Feet too narrow
faults.cue: Jump your feet wider — land just past shoulder width

faults.label: Bent arms
faults.cue: Keep your arms long — straighten through the elbows
faults.cue_side: Straighten your {side} arm through the whole swing

correction_tips: Reach your arms fully overhead on every rep
Keep your arms long, not bent
Land softly on the balls of your feet
exercise.voice_intro: Let's do jumping jacks! Reach all the way overhead and land softly.
